brandInfo.name: GKWebTech
brandInfo.agencyType: Full-Service Digital Marketing & Web Development Agency
brandInfo.positioning: Data-driven growth partners focusing on measurable ROI and scalable digital infrastructure.
brandInfo.tone: Professional, Consultant, Data-Backed, Transparent, authoritative but accessible.

SEO Optimization.description: Comprehensive search engine optimization focusing on technical health, on-page content, and authoritative backlink profiles to improve organic rankings.
SEO Optimization.whoItsFor: Businesses seeking long-term organic traffic growth and improved search visibility.

Social Media Marketing.description: Strategic management of social platforms to build community, increase brand awareness, and drive engagement through curated content.
Social Media Marketing.whoItsFor: Brands wanting to build a loyal audience and maintain active communication channels.

Content Creation.description: Production of high-quality assets including blogs, videos, graphics, and copy designed to educate, entertain, and convert audiences.
Content Creation.whoItsFor: Companies needing consistent, high-value content for various marketing channels.

Google & Meta Ads.description: Paid advertising campaigns on Google (Search, Display) and Meta (Facebook, Instagram) optimized for high conversion and ROI.
Google & Meta Ads.whoItsFor: Businesses looking for immediate traffic, lead generation, and sales acceleration.

Campaign Planning & Analytics.description: Strategic roadmap development and deep-dive data analysis to optimize marketing performance and budget allocation.
Campaign Planning & Analytics.whoItsFor: Organizations requiring data-backed insights to refine their marketing strategies.

Branding & Design.description: Creation of cohesive brand identities, including logos, visual guidelines, and marketing collateral.
Branding & Design.whoItsFor: Startups establishing their identity or established businesses rebranding for growth.

Website Development.description: Custom-coded, high-performance websites built with modern technologies (Next.js, React) for speed, security, and scalability.
Website Development.whoItsFor: Businesses requiring bespoke functionality, superior performance, and unique design beyond template limitations.

Website Management.description: Ongoing maintenance, security updates, and content management to ensure optimal website performance.
Website Management.whoItsFor: Companies wanting to outsource technical maintenance and ensure uptime.

Marketing Automation.description: Implementation of automated workflows for email, CRM, and lead nurturing to save time and increase efficiency.
Marketing Automation.whoItsFor: Teams looking to streamline operations and nurture leads automatically.

AI-Driven Workflows.description: Integration of AI tools to enhance productivity, content generation, and customer interaction processes.
AI-Driven Workflows.whoItsFor: Forward-thinking businesses aiming to leverage AI for competitive advantage.

CRO & Funnel Optimization.description: Systematic testing and optimization of website elements and sales funnels to maximize conversion rates.
CRO & Funnel Optimization.whoItsFor: Businesses with existing traffic looking to increase lead volume and revenue.

pricingPhilosophy.publicVisibility: No fixed final prices are shown publicly to ensure accuracy and fairness.
pricingPhilosophy.methodology: Transparent range-based pricing dependent on project scope, complexity, and specific deliverables.
pricingPhilosophy.webDevelopment: Always custom-quoted due to the unique nature of requirements and tech stack.
pricingPhilosophy.addOns: Additional features or expedited timelines will increase the base investment.
pricingPhilosophy.packages: Standard packages include a defined set of base services; deviations require a custom quote.
pricingPhilosophy.finalization: All final pricing is confirmed only after a strategy call and scope agreement.
pricingPhilosophy.bundlesVsCustom: Bundles offer cost efficiency for standard needs; Custom solutions provide exact fit for complex requirements.

singleService.purpose: Focused solution for a specific need.
singleService.idealClient: Businesses with a gap in a specific area (e.g., only need SEO).
singleService.whenCustomQuoteRequired: If requirements exceed standard tier limits.

growthBundles.purpose: Integrated approach to accelerate growth using multiple channels.
growthBundles.idealClient: SMEs looking for a holistic marketing push.
growthBundles.includedServices: Combination of SEO, Social Media, and Content.
growthBundles.whenCustomQuoteRequired: When adding significant custom functionality or extra channels.

multiServicePlans.idealClient: Brands outsourcing their entire digital marketing department.
multiServicePlans.includedServices: Strategy, Execution, Analytics across multiple disciplines.
multiServicePlans.whenCustomQuoteRequired: Almost always, to align with business goals.

enterprisePlans.includedServices: Full-suite agency services with dedicated account management.

customBuild.purpose: Unique projects not fitting standard categories.
customBuild.idealClient: Clients with specialized technical or creative needs.

customQuoteFlow.whatUserSees: An estimated price range based on selected options.
customQuoteFlow.whatIsNotFinal: The online calculator result is an estimate, not a binding invoice.
customQuoteFlow.emailConfirmation: User receives a breakdown of their selected preferences and the estimated range.
customQuoteFlow.internalNotification: Admin receives full lead details including selected plan and addons.
customQuoteFlow.salesFollowUp: Team reviews requirements and prepares for the strategy call.

leadAndEmailSystem.landingFormBehavior: Captures contact details and intent; redirects to thank you/booking page.
leadAndEmailSystem.pricingFormBehavior: Calculates estimate; captures detailed project scope; triggers email summary.
leadAndEmailSystem.databaseStorage: Leads are stored in the admin database with full schema details.
leadAndEmailSystem.internalEmailLogic: Instant notification to agency admins with lead scoring/details.
leadAndEmailSystem.clientConfirmationLogic: Auto-responder confirms receipt and sets expectations for next steps.
leadAndEmailSystem.futurePdfPlans: Roadmap includes generating PDF proposals automatically from valid submissions.

seoInfrastructure.wwwRedirect: Redirects to non-www or canonical version as configured.

faqKnowledgeBase.How much does SEO cost: SEO pricing varies based on competition, current site health, and goals. We provide a custom range after a quick audit.
faqKnowledgeBase.Do you show final prices: No. We show estimated ranges. Final pricing is confirmed after understanding your specific context to ensure fairness.
faqKnowledgeBase.Can I customize plans: Yes, absolutely. Our packages are starting points. We can tailor any plan to fit your specific needs.
faqKnowledgeBase.Is website included: Website development is a separate, custom service unless explicitly bundled in a special comprehensive growth package.
faqKnowledgeBase.Do you work internationally: Yes, we serve clients globally, with a strong presence in India and the Netherlands.
faqKnowledgeBase.Which currencies accepted: We primarily accept INR, EUR, and USD.
faqKnowledgeBase.When will someone contact me: Typically within 24 business hours after you submit an inquiry.
faqKnowledgeBase.Do you provide proposals: Yes, after our initial discovery call, we provide a detailed proposal outlining strategy, scope, and investment.
faqKnowledgeBase.Is automation included: Basic automation is part of some packages; complex workflows are a separate service.

chatbotBehaviorRules.neverGuessPricing: Do not guess a price. Refer to the 'Starting at' ranges or the custom quote calculator.
chatbotBehaviorRules.neverPromiseDiscounts: Do not authorize or promise discounts. Leave negotiation to the sales team.
chatbotBehaviorRules.alwaysExplainRanges: Always clarify that online figures are estimates/ranges.
chatbotBehaviorRules.routeToProposalCall: The primary goal is to get the user to book a strategy call or submit a detailed form.
chatbotBehaviorRules.askClarifyingQuestions: If a user is vague, ask 1-2 clarifying questions to guide them to the right service.
chatbotBehaviorRules.toneGuidelines: Helpful, professional, knowledgeable, but prudent regarding commitments.
chatbotBehaviorRules.avoidCompetitorTalk: Focus on GKWebTech's value proposition; do not disparage competitors.
chatbotBehaviorRules.mentionPricingPage: Direct users to the pricing page for a self-service estimate.
chatbotBehaviorRules.encourageCustomQuote: For complex needs, strongly suggest the custom quote path.

updatePolicy.whenToUpdateFile: Whenever service offerings, base pricing structures, or brand positioning changes.
